assessments.sourceExcerpt: If the stress-caused bleaching is not severe, coral have been known to recover.
assessments.sourceMeaning: Some corals with non-severe, stress-caused bleaching have recovered, so bleaching in that stated circumstance does not mean the coral is dead.
assessments.explanation: Known recovery after non-severe bleaching supports the claim that bleaching does not necessarily mean death.
